title: About
h1: Not an agency. A partner that runs the business as a whole.
lead: We start with an audit, including the financials. We define the core of the business. We build the system: websites, CRM, telephony, AI. We package it: brand, content, PR. We bring in clients: advertising and SEO. We support the deals: tenders and legal.

approach.name: Diagnostics
approach.text: Business, market, product, data and processes.

approach.name: Core
approach.text: Product, audience, positioning, value, offer, message.

approach.name: System
approach.text: Marketing, digital, sales, CRM, analytics. We build and automate.

approach.name: Growth
approach.text: We implement, measure the business result and scale what has proven to work.

why.name: Business first
why.text: Every decision is judged by the task and the result.

why.name: Execution
why.text: We don't stop at strategy — we implement the system.

why.name: One team
why.text: Marketing, technology, finance, tenders and legal join the task as needed.

formats.name: Audit & roadmap
formats.text: Diagnostics, a map of problems and opportunities, a 3–12 month plan.

formats.name: Project launch
formats.text: A website, CRM, brand, ad campaign or tender — delivered turnkey with a clear result.

formats.name: Growth partnership
formats.text: Long-term support: the system, the team, a measurable business result.

geoLead: Team and projects across Europe, Ukraine, Kazakhstan and Asia.
teamLead: Behind every CYBERMOVE project are people with real operating experience — from strategy and brand launches to AI automation, tenders and legal support.
